name: Charlotte Maxeke, Activist Hero
shortDescription: Discover how Charlotte Maxeke used education, courage and organised action to become a pioneering South African leader and defender of human rights.
longDescription: Charlotte Maxeke, Activist Hero introduces young viewers to a remarkable South African educator, organiser and social activist. From pursuing an education at a time when opportunities for Black women were severely restricted to becoming the first Black South African woman to earn a university degree, Charlotte turned learning into service. The story follows her leadership in community and church organisations, her resistance to injustice and her work for women’s rights. It helps children explore perseverance, equality, civic participation and the power of education to prepare someone to improve the lives of others.
